card_data.name: NAIF Technical Rescue Agent
card_data.description: Public technical rescue agent for API, EVM RPC and webhook failures. Returns sanitized FixGraph matches and bounded repair packets without auto-executing changes.

skills.name: Technical Rescue
skills.description: Match API, RPC and webhook failures to safe diagnostic guidance and bounded fixes.

skills.name: Repair Packet
skills.description: Return a machine-readable repair packet with causes, checks, guardrails, free diagnostic and FixGraph URL.
examples: Give me a repair packet for this API failure

skills.name: Signed Rescue Receipt
skills.description: Issue a privacy-preserving signed receipt after a matched technical rescue so agents can verify the match and display the Rescue Mesh badge.
examples: Issue a verifiable rescue receipt for this matched failure

skills.name: Agent Trust Passport
skills.description: Issue a signed point-in-time technical passport for an agent domain that explicitly opts in through its own trust manifest.
examples: Create a technical trust passport for this opted-in agent

skills.name: Delegation Preflight
skills.description: Re-check an opted-in agent before delegation and return a short-lived signed technical preflight token.
examples: Check this agent immediately before I delegate a task

skills.name: Agent Traffic Intelligence
skills.description: Share privacy-preserving route-class observations and query aggregated recent degradation signals before agent work.
examples: Check recent aggregate MCP route health before I start this task

skills.name: Cross-Agent Continuity
skills.description: Create, verify, checkpoint, hand off and resume signed sanitized task capsules across agents without storing raw task state on the continuity server.
examples: Package this task so another agent can resume from the verified state

skills.name: Adaptive Agent Marketplace
skills.description: Learn aggregate agent demand, surface temporary agent-only introductory offers, and incubate new service candidates without mutating the core storefront catalog.
examples: Show me the current offer for an MCP recovery need
